subject: Numbers clearance + commit ops checklist for investor packet
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2027 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Numbers clearance + commit ops checklist for investor packet

Team —

We have the investor packet due to legal/IR next week and I need a quick numbers clearance run. This thread is the single source of truth for the following (deadline: EOD Monday 12/13):

- Confirm ARR delta vs last board packet (line items + reductions). See attached snapshot (2027_Q4_bookings_snapshot.xlsx).
- Finalize commit-level hygiene: for all deals in the $50k+ corridor, update close dates, weighted stage, and short justification in the commit_sweep_log.csv.
- Identify any new bookings at risk and provide one-line mitigation + fallback model (e.g., downgrade estimate, push to next quarter).
- Collect supporting evidence links or artifacts (contracts, signed SOWs, PO emails) and add them to the Drive packet.

Practical asks:
- Vivek: please run the bookings roll-forward and highlight any ARR items that changed >$25k since last packet.
- Ben: own the commit sweep for west-region deals (list in HS-987654). Add short notes in the CSV for each deal.
- Laura: compile evidence stubs we can attach to the packet, prioritize audit-friendly items (signed PDFs, DocuSign ids).

I'll be circulating a brief executive summary once we have the cleaned numbers — keep comments inline in the CSV and add a single-sentence rationale when you change a commit.

Attachments: 2027_Q4_bookings_snapshot.xlsx (spreadsheet), commit_sweep_log.csv (CSV)

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2027 11:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Numbers clearance + commit ops checklist for investor packet

Vanessa —

I ran the bookings roll-forward and attached a short summary in the Drive link (also added inline rows in 2027_Q4_bookings_snapshot.xlsx). High-level findings:
- Net ARR movement: +$112k vs prior packet, driven by two acceleration credits reversing (one true-up, one timing).
- One large renewal (STR-4512) moved $120k out to next quarter due to procurement timing — flagged as "timing risk".
- Two smaller upgrades (+$38k combined) were double-counted previously — I've corrected and annotated.

Actioning:
- I will mark any adjustments >$25k with an explicit delta comment and link the supporting email thread.
- Pushed updated snapshot to Drive and added an comments column.

Vivek
Sr. Director, Revenue
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 10 Dec 2027 09:05:00 -0800

On Fri, Dec 10, 2027 at 8:14 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> We have the investor packet due to legal/IR next week and I need a quick numbers clearance run.

I've completed the west-region commit sweep and updated commit_sweep_log.csv. Notes on the big ones (all entries in CSV have one-line rationale):
- STR-4512 (Renewal): procurement delay; revised close date to 2028-01-18; conservatively moved $120k to "commit-push". Contact: Elena Ruiz (StrataCloud).
- NIM-3789 (Expansion): pushed from "Best Case" to "Commit" after signed SOW received; added DocuSign id DS-44321.
- NEW-9901 (Proof-of-Concept conversion): marked as "At-Risk" with mitigation: assign SE to run expedited handshake next week.

I attached the CSV in Drive and included the HubSpot link for the deals. Will follow up with short email copies of PO/SOW where available.

Ben
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Dec 2027 15:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Numbers clearance + commit ops checklist for investor packet

Thanks — I pulled the updated CSV and snapshot. Quick evidence status:
- STR-4512: procurement email (Elena) and draft PO in Drive under /evidence/STR-4512 (PDF).
- NIM-3789: DocuSign complete — DS-44321 saved and referenced in the CSV.
- NEW-9901: no signed artifact yet; SE confirmation note saved as "expedite-NEW-9901.md".

I'll assemble the evidence_readme (investor_evidence_readme.md) with direct links to each artifact and a one-line admissibility note (who verified it and when). Expect a first pass by Monday morning.

Laura Bennett
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Maya Jansen <cfo@stratacloud.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Dec 2027 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Numbers clearance + commit ops checklist for investor packet

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Two closing notes before I hand the packet to IR/legal Monday: 

1) Please ensure every CSV row that changed has a single-sentence justification and a link to evidence (or a "mitigation plan" note). Legal needs traceability.
2) Any items we cannot evidence must be flagged with an "Assumption" tag and a suggested conservative adjustment. We'll include an assumptions appendix in the packet.

I'll consolidate the numbers and deliver a clean summary to the board leads on Monday morning. If anything material (> $50k net movement) appears after EOD Monday, escalate to me directly.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: investor_evidence_readme.md (will be added to Drive), commit_sweep_log.csv (spreadsheet)
